items.reason: Untrusted event text no longer enters agent-review.yml in any form: the PR body, the base revision and the PR number are read out of $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH (new scripts/workflow-event.mjs, and the runner's jq in the `judgment` job, which may not execute repository code before its wipe-to-base) and reach the reviewer as a file, so there is no `github.event.*` left in any workflow — enforced by new blocking rule P9 in scripts/actions-pin.mjs and asserted independently by test-unit/workflow-injection.test.mjs.

Needs network: pinning the 25 action references means asking GitHub what each tag points at right now, and a fabricated SHA breaks CI rather than pinning it; the close is one networked run of `npm run actions:pin`, which already rewrites every workflow AND writes STRICT = true / RATCHET.pinned back into scripts/actions-pin.mjs in the same pass, and Dependabot's github-actions ecosystem is already configured to keep the pins fresh — so there is no offline half worth landing.

lessons: This repository answers a D9 finding with a blocking zero-dependency script in scripts/ PLUS a unit test that asserts the script still evaluates the rule — read scripts/*.mjs and test-unit/workflow-*.test.mjs before treating a scanner hit as an open gap, and when the existing gate already covers the class, the useful move is to tighten it a rung (shape -> presence) rather than to restate it.

The `judgment` job in .github/workflows/agent-review.yml is the one place here holding a secret and a write scope, and test-unit/workflow-injection.test.mjs fails if it runs node/npm/npx before `git clean -ffdx` moves its tree to the base. Any helper script you add for workflow hardening cannot be used in that job before the wipe — use tooling from the runner image there and say why in the step's comment.

Action pinning here is deliberately one atomic networked command: `npm run actions:pin` resolves the digests, rewrites the workflows, and flips STRICT/RATCHET.pinned in scripts/actions-pin.mjs, because pins that nothing enforces come undone on the next Dependabot bump. Half of it offline is worse than none.
